description: How many people search Google each month for a keyword in a city, region or country, as a range such as 1K–10K (via LeadQuasar KeywordQuasar), with up to 5 related searches and their ranges and about how many matching businesses LeadQuasar holds there. Exact figures are on LeadQuasar's Plus and Max plans. Use this to answer questions like 'how many people search for plumber in Austin' or 'search volume for wedding photographer in Manchester'. When the place name matches several places the response lists them under `choose`: ask the user which, then call again with that place's geoId. Each connection has a few lookups a day; quote `source` and give `link` with the numbers. Contact details are never returned. For bulk or scheduled lookups in the user's own software, the same report is the KeywordQuasar REST API on Plus and Max: https://leadquasar.com/keyword-research-api.

country.description: Optional two-letter ISO country code ("US", "GB", "DE") to narrow the place.

geoId.description: Only a geoId from a `choose` list this tool returned, after the user picked one.

keyword.description: The search term, e.g. "plumber" or "emergency plumber". 2 to 80 characters.

location.description: A city, region or country, e.g. "Austin, TX", "Manchester", "Germany". Any country.

title: Keyword search volume
